title: IPM-FM: A Foundation Model with Consensus Feature Selection for Industrial Process Monitoring
abstract: arXiv:2609.08375v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Industrial process monitoring is fundamental to the safety and economic performance of modern process plants. Current practice remains a one-task-one-model paradigm that is label-inefficient and prone to degradation under operating drift. Foundation models have reshaped language, vision, and generic time-series forecasting, but it has not been adapted to industrial process monitoring. This setting poses domain-specific challenges, including safety-critical decisions and asymmetric sampling between process variables and laboratory measurements. We propose the industrial process monitoring foundation model (IPM-FM). It first learns general-purpose representations from unlabeled industrial process data through self-supervised pretraining, then adapts to specific monitoring tasks using a small amount of task-labeled data, and finally produces calibrated predictions through an uncertainty-aware prediction head. translated_title: IPM-FM：一种具有共识特征选择的工业过程监控基础模型
translated_abstract: 工业过程监控是现代流程工厂安全运行和经济效益的基础。当前的实践仍然遵循“一个任务一个模型”的范式，这种范式标签利用效率低下，并且在工况漂移下容易出现性能退化。基础模型已经重塑了语言、视觉和通用时间序列预测领域，但尚未被应用于工业过程监控。这一场景带来了领域特有的挑战，包括安全关键决策以及过程变量与实验室测量之间的不对称采样问题。我们提出了工业过程监控基础模型（IPM-FM）。它首先通过自监督预训练从无标签的工业过程数据中学习通用表征，然后利用少量任务标注数据适应特定的监控任务，最后通过不确定性感知的预测头产生经过校准的预测。IPM-FM集成了一个自监督……
tldr: 本文提出首个面向工业过程监控的基础模型IPM-FM，通过自监督预训练学习通用表征、少量标注数据进行任务适配、并以不确定性感知预测头输出校准预测，突破了传统“一任务一模型”范式在标签效率和工况漂移下的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes IPM-FM, the first foundation model for industrial process monitoring, which learns general-purpose representations via self-supervised pretraining, adapts to specific tasks with minimal labeled data, and delivers calibrated predictions through an uncertainty-aware prediction head, overcoming the label inefficiency and performance degradation of the traditional one-task-one-model paradigm.
